Code Coverage — ASME, API, ISO, ASTM, NACE, IS, AERB

Indian cohorts cover ASME B&PV Section V Article 2 (RT), Article 4 (UT + PAUT + TOFD), Article 6 (PT), Article 7 (MT), Article 8 (ET), Article 9 (VT); API 510/570/653 in-service inspection; API RP 571 damage mechanisms (sulfidation, naphthenic-acid for coker-feedstock units, HTHA for hydrocrackers, amine cracking, CUI for coastal refineries, MIC); API RP 580/581 RBI; API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 FFS; ISO 9712:2022 third-party; ISO 17636-1/-2; ISO 17640; ASTM E2491 PAUT; NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sour service; IS 11829 (Indian Standard for industrial radiography); AERB (Atomic Energy Regulatory Board) §3 industrial radiography licensing per ISTR (radiation safety officer requirement). See API 510, API 570, API 653, ASNT.

AERB Radiation Safety — The India-Specific Gate Most Foreign Courses Miss

Industrial radiography in India requires AERB licensing under the Atomic Energy Act + AERB Safety Code AERB/SC/IR-1 — Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) per ISTR-1 + Radiographer per ISTR-2 + Radiographer's Assistant per ISTR-3. Foreign-trained inspectors mobilising to Reliance / IOCL / NTPC sites cannot perform RT without AERB endorsement. Atlantis Indian cohorts bundle AERB RSO + ISTR preparation alongside ASNT/ISO 9712 RT certification — this is a critical India-specific pathway absent from foreign cohorts.

Reliance Jamnagar — The Largest Single-Site Refining Complex Globally

Reliance Industries Jamnagar refining complex runs one of the most complex damage-mechanism stacks globally: sulfidation per API RP 571 §4.4.2 across crude trains, naphthenic-acid §4.4.7 on heavy-end vacuum side-draws, HTHA §5.1.3.1 across the hydrocracker + isomerisation + hydrotreater fleet (Nelson-curve overlay per API RP 941), amine cracking §5.1.2.3 on every acid-gas removal train (NACE SP0472 PWHT mandatory), CUI §4.3.5 across coastal salt-laden air + monsoon humidity (API RP 583 strategy), chloride SCC §4.5.1 on austenitic stainless seawater cooling + brine systems, MIC §5.1.1.6 on stagnant seawater, FAC §4.2.14 on utility steam, HIC/SOHIC §5.1.2.4 on sour vessels. Reliance technician + inspector throughput requires Level II UT + PAUT + TOFD + RT + MT + PT + VT + ET stack with API 510 + API 570 + API 653 layered on top — Atlantis Hyderabad runs the dedicated Reliance feeder cohort monthly.

NTPC Ultra-Supercritical Power — Creep, FAC, and the Long-Range UT Frontier

NTPC Vindhyachal + Rihand + Talcher + Sipat ultra-supercritical boilers operate above 600°C main steam driving creep per API 579-1 Part 10 on superheater + reheater header welds + steam-pipe girth welds + turbine casings. FAC per API RP 571 §4.2.14 on economiser + LP feedwater piping below 250°C single-phase water demands UT thickness grids on the inside-elbow extrados every refurbishment cycle. Long-range UT (guided wave per ISO 18211) on buried + insulated piping reduces excavation cost dramatically. Indian Boiler Regulations 1950 (IBR) impose statutory inspection at hydrostatic-test pressure + every 12-month operational survey — Atlantis Indian cohorts bundle IBR-licensed inspector pathway alongside ASNT + API 510 / 570.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Does Reliance Jamnagar require ASNT or ISO 9712?

A: Reliance accepts both; ASNT Level II + API 510/570/653 is the dominant profile. ISO 9712:2022 dual-stamp is preferred for cross-mobilisation to Aramco / ADNOC contractor pools.

Q2: Do I need AERB licensing for industrial RT in India?

A: Yes — AERB RSO + ISTR Radiographer endorsement is mandatory per AERB Safety Code AERB/SC/IR-1. Foreign certifications do not substitute.

Q3: How long do Indian cohorts run?

A: 5-day intensives for single-method Level II. Multi-method runs 2-3 weeks back-to-back. ASNT Level III multi-method runs monthly in Hyderabad.
